title: Cartesian conversion maps negative coordinate axes incorrectly
description:
indigo_align.c:471-478: cartesian_to_spherical returns north pole for both signs of z when x=y=0, and returns a=0 for y=0 regardless of negative x. Thus normalized (-1,0,0) converts to the opposite longitude and (0,0,-1) to the opposite pole. Polar error apply/correct call this conversion. Next: Use atan2 for non-pole longitude and distinguish south/north pole; clamp/normalize z according to stated unit-vector contract. Verify axis round trips and identity rotations.
